subject: Round-robin onboarding slot reassignment
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearmap.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to reassign onboarding slots (ClearMap)

Hi Irene,

We need to shift the onboarding we booked for next week — a few folks on our APAC team flagged a conflict with an all-hands that just moved. The current session owner is Marissa, but given the headcount change we were wondering if Redwood can reassign sessions using a round-robin so different trainers cover shorter blocks across timezones. That would help split the load across our engineers in APAC and EMEA.

Preferable options from our side: 1) split into two 90-minute blocks on Sep 21 (morning APAC / late EMEA) or 2) keep a single 3-hour block but move it 30 minutes earlier. If neither works, send a set of your available alternatives and we’ll pick.

I attached our internal checklist (MVP-access-checklist.pdf) — it lists accounts that need pre-provisioning and a short preflight test. We’ll need API keys provisioned 48 hours before.

Thanks,
Samir
Lead Platform Engineer, ClearMap

Subject: Re: Request to reassign onboarding slots (ClearMap)

Thanks Samir — appreciate the heads up.

Quick read: splitting into two 90-minute blocks is doable and likely the best experience for your distributed team. Ben, Marissa — are you able to rotate trainers across the two blocks if we run a round-robin? Preferably Ben takes the first block and Marissa leads the second, unless you prefer otherwise.

Samir — I created a short poll (link below) with 4 candidate windows across Sep 21–23 that attempt to cover APAC mornings / EMEA late afternoons. Can you, or your coordinator, pick the preferred slot by EOD tomorrow? If the team needs a strict earlier offset (30 min), add that as a comment in the poll and we’ll try to accommodate.

Proposed plan if you pick split:
- Block A (trainer: Ben): labs & console walkthrough (90m)
- Block B (trainer: Marissa): API enablement + live API keys handshake (90m)
- We’ll provision temporary API keys and a sandbox project 48 hrs before the earliest block.

I’m attaching the preflight template Ben mentioned; please populate and return (preflight-reqs.xlsx). I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we have a confirmed slot.

Poll: https://forms.office.com/r/slot-poll-clarify
Drive preflight folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_preflight

— Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks — we reviewed the poll. The team can do the split (option: Sep 22). One ask: can you start Block A 30 minutes earlier than the times in the poll? Our APAC engineers have a standing call at the time slot you listed and shifting earlier by 30 minutes avoids that. If moving earlier is not possible for trainer availability, we can accept the later slot but prefer to avoid.

Also: we’ve filled the preflight sheet and uploaded it to the Drive link. Can you confirm API key handoff process? For compliance I need a DocuSign confirmation for the sandbox access terms — happy to sign quickly if you can send the agreement.

I can be reached on Slack for quick decisions but please also keep the calendar invite updated.

Notes for the session:
- Ben will cover console walkthrough, account setup, and lab orchestration.
- Marissa will cover API enablement and live key handshake; we’ll schedule the key provisioning 48 hours prior (Irene will trigger).
- We’ll provide a short DocuSign agreement for sandbox terms; Samir, expect that in your inbox within 2 hours — reply to sign and we’ll provision temporary keys after sign-off.

Samir — I placed a placeholder invite on Sep 22, 08:30 APAC (see attached .ics). If that time shows incorrectly in your timezone, accept and the calendar should translate; otherwise tell me preferred display time and I’ll update.
